verdict.rationale: Parahelp's core interaction model is natural-language: users describe the flow/support automation they want and the Internal Agent configures it, and prompting the Internal Agent for reports/testing scenarios is a documented interaction pattern. This is first-party docs only, with no independent/hands-on corroboration of how robust the NL command interface is in practice. Missing for 10: independent user validation of NL command reliability, and any examples of complex/ambiguous NL commands being handled.
